run_motion_from_glb: run a Python program that loads a GLB motion file and animates an actor in the AI4Animation scene
load_motion_from_glb: load motion data from a GLB file using Motion.LoadFromGLB with bone names and floor parameters
add_actor_to_scene: add an Actor component to the AI4Animation scene using Scene.AddEntity and AddComponent with a model GLB path
get_bone_transformations: get bone transformations at a specific timestamp from a Motion object using GetBoneTransformations with optional mirroring
sync_actor_to_scene: apply bone transformations to an Actor and sync it to the scene using SetTransforms and SyncToScene
